title: Charity does not decrease wealth
preview: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that giving in charity does not decrease one's wealth.
content:
# Charity does not decrease wealth

*Narrated by Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)*

The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said:

**"Wealth is not diminished by giving in charity."**

Allah (glorified and exalted be He) replaces what we give and increases our provision when we spend in His cause. This hadith encourages Muslims to give generously without fear of loss.

---

*Reference: Sahih Muslim*

title: Paradise lies at the feet of mothers
preview: The Prophet (SAW) said: "Paradise lies at the feet of mothers."
content:
# Paradise lies at the feet of mothers

*Narrated by Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)*

A man came to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and asked: **"Who among people is most deserving of my good companionship?"**

The Prophet said: **"Your mother."** The man asked again: "Then who?" The Prophet said: **"Your mother."** The man asked a third time: "Then who?" The Prophet said: **"Your mother."** The man asked a fourth time: "Then who?" The Prophet said: **"Your father."**

---

*Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5971*

title: The best charity is that given in secret
preview: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that among those shaded by Allah on the Day of Judgment is one who gives charity so secretly that his left hand does not know what his right has given.
content:
# The best charity is that given in secret

*Narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)*

The Prophet said: **"Seven people will be shaded by Allah on the Day when there will be no shade except His: a just ruler; a youth who grew up in the worship of Allah; a man whose heart is attached to the mosques; two men who love each other for the sake of Allah, meeting and parting for that reason; a man who gives charity so secretly that his left hand does not know what his right hand has given..."**

Giving in secret purifies the intention and protects the recipient from embarrassment.

---

*Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1423*

title: Seeking knowledge is an obligation
preview: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.
content:
# Seeking knowledge is an obligation

*Narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)*

The Messenger of Allah said: **"Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim."**

This includes both religious knowledge and beneficial worldly knowledge. The believer is encouraged to learn throughout life and to teach others what is good.

---

*Reference: Sunan Ibn Majah 224*

title: A smile is charity
preview: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that smiling in the face of your brother is charity.
content:
# A smile is charity

*Narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)*

The Prophet said: **"Every good deed is charity. Indeed among good deeds is meeting your brother with a cheerful face and pouring water from your bucket into your brother's vessel."**

Simple acts of kindness and a pleasant disposition count as charity in Islam.

---

*Reference: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 1970*
